text_blocks.snippet: If a family member has COVID-19, prioritize isolating them from the rest of the household to minimize transmission. If possible, designate a separate room and bathroom for the infected individual. Encourage the use of face masks when others must enter their space, and maintain good ventilation by opening windows. Frequent handwashing and disinfecting surfaces are crucial, especially if sharing restrooms or common areas. If the infected person must leave their room, they should wear a mask and minimize contact with others. If you are providing care, consider staying home to limit potential exposure to those outside the household.
